translations.english: This mountain with its peaks is adorned with various minerals. Some of the regions have the radiance of silver and bronze, some look bloodred or maddercrimson, some sparkle like the rarest of gems while others shine like topaz or crystal or a flower of ketaka plant or shimmer like stars and quicksilver.
translations.hindi: हे पुरुपप्रमर ! तुम अपनी सेना को दूर छोड, अकेले क्यों मेरे पंस आए । सेना सहित मेरे आश्रम में न आने का क्या कारण है?
